delete_account.confirm_title: Are you sure you want to delete your account?

passkeys.empty_body: Add a passkey to sign in without a password
passkeys.name_help: A name to help you identify this passkey
passkeys.not_supported: Passkeys are not supported in this browser.

two_factor_manage.title: Two-factor authentication
two_factor_manage.enabled_help: You will be prompted for a secure, random pin during login, which you can retrieve from the TOTP-supported application on your phone.
two_factor_manage.disabled_help: When you enable two-factor authentication, you will be prompted for a secure pin during login. This pin can be retrieved from a TOTP-supported application on your phone.
two_factor_manage.enabled_body: Two-factor authentication is now enabled. Scan the QR code or enter the setup key in your authenticator app.
two_factor_manage.verify_body: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app
two_factor_manage.enable_body: To finish enabling two-factor authentication, scan the QR code or enter the setup key in your authenticator app
two_factor_manage.recovery_description: Recovery codes let you regain access if you lose your authenticator device. Store them in a secure password manager.
